Header: Pomacea canaliculata, P. maculata Shwe Ka Yu (Burmese)

Prevention: Snails are present in moist areas, but can stay in the soil more than 5 months
Flood the whole field before planting, then collect and destroy these snails because they are going to emerge when water is in the field (farmers to cooperate if possible)
Release ducks which eat snails before planting
Use the transplanting method instead of direct seeding because snails can attack the newly emerging seedlings
Apply limestone powder around the bund of field before planting to prevent snail invasion from neighbouring field
Rotate crop with dry land crops and /or allow a fallow period
Monitoring: Monitor the snails in seedling stage about 15 days after transplanting in both early morning and night; but during daytime they are difficult to find
Search egg mass of bright pink colour on leaves that is depending on water level (usually egg mass on leaves at 6 inches- 1 feet of water level)
Find adult snails with yellow or dark brown shell when they eat the young leaves
Consider action when 3-10 snails are found per 10 m2 because they can reproduce rapidly by 1000-1200 eggs within one month

It is often too late to take action if there are more than 15 snails per 10 m2 of field, this indicates a high risk of damage because they can destroy 1 m2 of field overnight and it could lead to more than 50% yield loss
Direct Control: Check seed beds and newly transplanted field several times a day and hand pick snails immediately

Place food traps in the corner of fields where water enters and exists; for that mix banana leaves, papaya leaves, and some sweet-smelling fruit like pineapple, mango into basket or 1-2 feet plastic bags and then put them at the same level of water in the field6 (the more you put, the more you can get snails)
Place bamboo stake traps around the field bund depending on field size and snails’ amount
Net; Use roll of bamboo chick or mesh bag at the inlet or outlet of irrigation canal or water gate way to prevent snail invade
Release ducks into the infected field frequently
Restrictions: When using a pesticide or botanical, always wear protective clothing and follow the instructions on the product label, such as dosage, timing of application, pre-harvest interval, max number of sprays, restricted re-entry interval.
Do not empty into drains and water sources.
Always consult recent list of registered pesticides
For all pesticide utilizations, comply with the product label
Alternate pesticides to avoid the resistance development by snails
